title: Optimal minimax formula for bounds on ensemble averages of statistically stationary three-dimensional Navier-Stokes flows
summary: We establish an optimal upper bound formula for ensemble averages of flow quantities associated with the three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. The formula takes the form of a minimax problem, extending the framework developed by Tobasco, Goluskin, and Doering (2018) for finite-dimensional systems and by Rosa and Temam (2022) for the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations. The lack of global well-posedness for the 3D case presents a significant challenge, which we overcome by working within the space of Foias-Prodi stationary statistical solutions.
